data.name: Couch PVP
data.detailed_description:
2 to 8 players, one screen

COUCH PVP is a local split-screen arena shooter. Pick a mode, grab a controller each (keyboard welcome), and the match begins. Games are short, timed, and always end the same way: a podium, a stats board, and a rematch one button away.

Easy to pick up — even for people who never play

  • Every mode is explained in one sentence, shown before kickoff.
  • Per-player aim assist: magnetic aiming and more forgiving shots. Beginners turn it on, veterans leave it off — and the match stays close.
  • The controls fit on a single screen shown at launch: move, jump, shoot.
  • Someone running late? A free controller is all it takes to join mid-game.

11 modes, from simple to devious

  • Team vs Team, King of the Hill, Football: rules that fit in one sentence.
  • Sticky Bomb: an explosive hot potato passed on contact.
  • Juggernaut: one overpowered boss against everyone — take them down, take their place.
  • Paintball: painted territory is the score.
  • Zone Capture, Heist!, TYCOON WAR: control, plunder and sabotage for the strategists.
  • Infection: every victim joins the pack.
  • Zombie Co-op: the cooperative mode — everyone together against the zombie waves.
Tournament chains rounds together with mode and map votes, wagers and point multipliers.

10 maps with signature events

A train barrels through the station, the tide redraws the island, a rocket lifts off mid-match, a bull charges across the farm. Every map has its signature event, ready to shuffle the deck at the worst possible moment — taking the lead is not enough, you have to last.

The end of the match is part of the game

A 3D podium, a stats wall, and a badge for everyone — from ON FIRE to PUNCHING BAG. The match history keeps your last 20 podiums, viewable from the menu: the scores stay, the arguments do not.

For every living room

  • 30 languages.
  • Accessibility options: colorblind modes, reduced flashes and screen shake, adjustable rumble and interface, remappable keys, per-player sensitivity.
  • Designed with the Steam Deck in mind.
  • Remote Play Together: one copy of the game is enough to play online with friends.

Ready when you are

Add COUCH PVP to your wishlist — and when game night comes, count controllers, not explanations.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible Vulkan 1.2 — GeForce GTX 750 Ti / Radeon RX 550 / Intel UHD 630
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64 bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64 bits)
  • Processor: Quadcore 2,5 GHz (Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU compatible Vulkan 1.2 with 2 Go VRAM (Intel UHD 620 / Radeon Vega 8 or better)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64 bits)
  • Processor: Quadcore 3 GHz (Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 560 or better (Vulkan 1.2)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
